answer_checks.gt_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(MAX(p.gross - o.owed, 0)),2) FROM (SELECT json_extract(cells,'$[0]') AS id, json_extract(cells,'$[4]') AS gross FROM sheet_rows WHERE file='payroll-register-2026-02-H2.xlsx' AND json_extract(cells,'$[0]') LIKE 'E-1%') p JOIN (SELECT json_extract(a.cells,'$[0]') AS id, (json_extract(a.cells,'$[3]') + CASE WHEN json_extract(a.cells,'$[5]')='LWOP' THEN 0 ELSE json_extract(a.cells,'$[4]') END) * json_extract(r.cells,'$[3]') AS owed FROM sheet_rows a JOIN sheet_rows r ON json_extract(r.cells,'$[0]')=json_extract(a.cells,'$[0]') WHERE a.file='attendance-export-2026-02-H2.xlsx' AND r.file='comp-rate-schedule-2026.xlsx' AND json_extract(a.cells,'$[0]') LIKE 'E-1%') o ON p.id=o.id
